definitions.explanation: The period when a female animal is ready to mate, or the season when animals breed.

examples.english: Cats often come into heat in spring.
Males become aggressive in the breeding season.

examples.japanese: {発情期|はつじょうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{鳴|な}き→鳴く：04388_naku⟧{続|つづ}ける。
examples.english: When she is in heat, our cat keeps yowling loudly in the middle of the night.

notes:
USAGE:
- Said of animals; used of people it is a crude joke.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発情期|はつじょうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to come into heat
- {発情|はつじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be in heat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {繁殖期|はんしょくき}: breeding season (neutral and scientific; of birds, fish and others)
